finalText:
Build passes clean now, 0 errors.

Two spots hadn't caught up to the new bundler's option shapes. In `src/core/options.js`, retry counts used to arrive as `retries`, but the bumped bundler now sends them as `retryCount`. The code was still reading the old name, so it crashed on `undefined`. Fixed it to read `retryCount`.

In `src/net/retryPolicy.js`, the backoff flag used to come back as `false` when unset. Now it comes back as `undefined`, and the check only handled `true` or `false`, so it threw an error on anything else. Fixed it to treat `undefined` the same as `false`.

The rest of the warnings were just deprecation noise from the bump, not real problems. Build now finishes with 8 warnings and 0 errors.
